knowledgeDocs.title: company-info
knowledgeDocs.body: Sable & Wren is a small mid-market furniture retailer — sofas, dining, beds and storage. Support inbox is hello@sableandwren.example, run by Nora. We reply to every customer in a warm, professional, personal voice. Ship-back / returns address: Sable & Wren Returns, 1120 Harbor Rd #204, Astoria, OR 97103. Store policies live at https://sableandwren.example/pages/return-policy. Founder Rae is referenced in some replies (e.g. the floor-model recommendation).

knowledgeDocs.title: delivery-and-assembly
knowledgeDocs.body: DELIVERY & ASSEMBLY. Threshold delivery (front door, ground floor) is standard; room-of-choice and White-Glove (unwrap, assemble, take the packaging away) are paid upgrades booked at checkout. Assembly issues: ask for the order number / email / name / delivery address to locate the purchase, offer to troubleshoot by photo/description over email. If they want someone to come out and do the assembly, that requires a paid White-Glove Assembly visit — otherwise the Assembly Guide walks them through it. Returns of assembled items carry a 20% restocking fee (flag for Nora).

knowledgeDocs.title: frame-warranty
knowledgeDocs.body:
FRAME WARRANTY — SEPARATE from the 30-day return window, do NOT conflate.
Harlow frames carry a 5-year warranty for MANUFACTURING DEFECTS ONLY; cushions and fabric carry 1 year. Step one on any sofa fault: find the delivery date in Shopify and check which window it falls in.
WITHIN the frame window: gather info (what's wrong, a photo for records, confirm the order). If confirmed a frame defect with no impact damage or misuse, ship a replacement frame section or a replacement piece; customer gets tracking when it ships.
OUTSIDE the window: no free replacement. Offer a personalized % off (e.g. 15%) toward the current collection — the DISCOUNT CODE IS CREATED MANUALLY BY NORA. Bean drafts the message and flags for Nora to create/insert the code.

knowledgeDocs.title: return-policy
knowledgeDocs.body:
RETURNS & EXCHANGES (general). Accepted within 30 days of delivery, item must be NEW, UNUSED and unassembled. See https://sableandwren.example/pages/return-policy.
Sofas: within 30 days we make an exception for STORE CREDIT (not cash refund) — see sofa-returns for the wrapped-vs-unwrapped rules.
Clearance and floor-model pieces: FINAL SALE, no returns.
RESTOCKING FEES (charged when an item comes back damaged / cannot be sold as new): Mattresses 45% (hard rule). Dining tables & bed frames 25% (hard rule). Rugs & curtains 20%. Assembled items 20%.
REFUND TIMING: 3–5 business days to appear.
NOTE: these numbers are policy. Bean should NOT quote a fee or process a refund on its own — restocking / refund / cancellation replies are flagged for Nora (stakes:high).

knowledgeDocs.title: sofa-product-info
knowledgeDocs.body:
HARLOW SOFA RANGE.
Design: kiln-dried hardwood frame, corner-blocked and doweled; sinuous-spring seat base; feather-wrapped foam cushions; legs unscrew for delivery access.
Fabric grades (3 types): Everyday Weave (cotton-linen blend, our standard), Performance Weave (stain- and scratch-resistant — the grade we recommend for households with pets or small children), Full-Grain Leather (wipes clean and ages to a patina, but is not scratch-proof). A home with dogs and a toddler wants Performance Weave. Swatch cards of all three ship free. We do NOT sell or accept customer's-own-material (COM) upholstery and do not recommend third-party fabric protectors.
Dimensions: 3-seater 84" W × 38" D × 33" H; 2-seater 62" W; sectional 112" W. Seat height 18". With the legs off the 3-seater frame is 29" deep, so it clears a 30" doorway; the sectional splits into two pieces at the chaise seam. Only one seat depth is offered per collection.
Collections: HARLOW II (2026) — deeper seat, tighter frame joinery, all three fabric grades. HARLOW I (2025) — same frame construction and cushion fill, shallower seat, Everyday Weave and Full-Grain Leather only. Both share the hardwood frame, sinuous-spring base, removable legs and cushion fill. Recommend Harlow II for seat depth and fabric choice; Harlow I if the customer wants the same frame for less and doesn't need Performance Weave.
Lifespan: the frame is built to outlast the upholstery — reupholstery mid-life is normal, not a failure.

knowledgeDocs.title: sofa-returns
knowledgeDocs.body:
SOFA RETURNS / EXCHANGES (money — flag for Nora).
Return within 30 days: if STILL WRAPPED and unassembled → full refund minus original delivery. If UNWRAPPED and used → we typically do NOT accept returns (upholstery is cut to order and cannot be sold as new); we can offer STORE CREDIT minus delivery.
Wrong fabric grade ordered: if STILL WRAPPED → exchange to the correct grade. If UNWRAPPED → offer a swap from the floor-model pool; customer covers freight both ways (~$149 return freight; ~$298 total); cannot guarantee an exact dye-lot match to the original.
Ship-back address: Sable & Wren Returns, 1120 Harbor Rd #204, Astoria, OR 97103.

knowledgeDocs.title: voice-and-tone
knowledgeDocs.body:
VOICE RULES (Nora's own words).
Always sound professional, helpful, and empathetic — this is customer service, the customer should feel heard and understood. Be helpful with clear, concise answers.
DO NOT say 'I am sorry you feel this way' or 'I'm sorry you do not like the product.' Avoid emotional 'sorry.' You MAY say sorry in a non-emotional way (e.g. 'I am sorry to hear you are experiencing issues with your product').
NEVER say 'it sounds like you received a defective piece.' Instead: 'I am sorry to hear that you are experiencing issues with your product. If you can send photos of the piece and of the area you are seeing the problem, we are happy to have it inspected, and if found to be defective, replace it.'
Open replies with a greeting like 'Thank you for reaching out to Sable & Wren!' Sign-off: TO BE CONFIRMED with Nora (do not invent one).

children.label: Sagging or squeaking
children.trigger: Seat sags, frame creaks, or a joint feels loose.
children.answer: Gather the order, ask which seat and when it started, ask for a photo, then check the frame window.

children.label: Cushion cover issue
children.trigger: Zip, seam, or a cover that no longer fits after washing.
children.answer: Covers are not machine washable; offer a replacement cover and confirm the fabric grade on the order.

children.label: Which fabric grade
children.trigger: Which of the three grades to pick — pets, children, wear, cleaning.
children.answer: Everyday Weave is standard; Performance Weave for pets or small children; Full-Grain Leather wipes clean but scratches. Free swatch cards.

children.label: Dimensions & doorway fit
children.trigger: Will it fit — doorway, stairwell, lift, room measurements.
children.answer: Give the collection's dimensions, note the legs unscrew (3-seater clears 30" with legs off) and the sectional splits at the chaise seam.

children.label: Harlow I vs Harlow II
children.trigger: Which collection, what changed between them.
children.answer: Same frame and fill; Harlow II has a deeper seat and all three fabric grades, Harlow I is Everyday Weave and Leather only.

children.label: Warranty claim (within 5 years)
children.trigger: Frame fault inside the frame warranty window.
children.answer: Confirm the delivery date in Shopify, gather photos, replace the frame section if confirmed defective with no impact damage.

children.label: Outside warranty / discount
children.trigger: Frame fault outside the window.
children.answer: No free replacement; offer a personalized % off the current collection. Nora creates the code.

children.label: Return / exchange
children.trigger: Wants to send the sofa back or swap the fabric grade.
children.answer: Wrapped and unassembled is a refund minus delivery; unwrapped is store credit. Flag the money for Nora.

children.label: Where is my order
children.trigger: Where is it, has it shipped, no confirmation yet.
children.answer: Look the order up by number, email, name or delivery address and give the real status and tracking.

children.label: Missed delivery window
children.trigger: The carrier did not arrive in the booked window.
children.answer: Apologise without emotional sorry, confirm the order, and rebook the window.

children.label: Cancel order
children.trigger: Wants to cancel before it ships.
children.answer: State the cancellation policy. Any exception or exact refund amount is Nora's.

children.label: Refund status / timing
children.trigger: Where is my refund, how long does it take.
children.answer: Refunds take 3–5 business days to appear once issued. Whether it was issued is Nora's.

children.label: Return eligibility / restocking fee
children.trigger: Can I return this, what will it cost me.
children.answer: 30 days, new, unused and unassembled. Never quote a restocking fee — flag for Nora.

children.trigger: Which sofa or fabric holds up to animals and children.
children.answer: Performance Weave on either collection; Harlow II if they want the deeper seat.

proposals.trigger: Customer writes about a mattress — which one to buy, firmness or a foundation, the sleep trial, or an exchange or return.
proposals.answer: Hi {name}, thank you for reaching out to Sable & Wren! I'd be glad to help with your mattress question. Could you share which mattress you have (or are looking at), how you sleep or what you'd like to do, and — if you've already ordered — the order number or the name or email on the order? If you're asking about a return or exchange, those are handled per our return policy, and I'll confirm the exact details for your specific order. I'll follow up with a full answer as soon as I have this from you.
